title: Simpli Blocks
description: A Mod That Adds new blocks that make great decorations and Go really good with create and clockwork
body:
Simpli Blocks Adds New Detail and non functional blocks that go great with the mods create and clockwork. it adds blocks like the rust plate, spare wheel, broken engine, steel plates and more. it also adds various tools to craft them such as the hammer and saw.

![Simpli Blocks Horizontal Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a3d95fd526b3755b7913fa2fdb49ea9ac4999bcc.png)

(simpli Blocks Does not have All Items Right now... i will add the rest in the mean time as well as a few more Blocks and Tools). This Mod is No Longer Updated.
